items.t: Plastic intake manifold cracks and leaks coolant
items.job: Replace intake manifold with updated design and gaskets
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $900 on average. Add a coolant flush if the engine overheated.

items.t: Rear air suspension sags or compressor fails
items.job: Replace rear air springs and air compressor (or convert to coil springs)
items.note: A pair of air springs alone costs much less. A coil-spring conversion is often the cheapest lasting fix.

items.t: Coolant leak at the front of the intake manifold
items.job: Replace intake manifold and gaskets

items.t: Automatic transmission slips or fails
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $3,300 on average. A used unit costs less.

items.t: Feels sluggish or shifts up too early
items.job: Repair transmission valve body (check ball)

items.t: Spark plug blown out of the cylinder head
items.job: Repair spark plug threads with an insert and replace plug and coil
items.note: Price is for one cylinder. CarComplaints owners report about $300.

items.t: Heater core leaks
items.job: Replace heater core
items.note: The dashboard has to come apart, so most of the cost is labor. CarComplaints owners report about $1,500.

items.t: Power windows stop working
items.job: Replace power window regulator and motor (one door)

items.t: Brake master cylinder fails
items.job: Replace brake master cylinder and bleed brakes
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $800 on average.

items.t: Ticking engine noise at idle
items.job: Diagnose valvetrain noise and replace cylinder head and camshaft (one side)
items.note: This is the worst case. Get a firm diagnosis before agreeing to head work.

items.t: Keyless remote and door keypad stop working
items.job: Repair wiring short under the seat

items.t: Blower fan quits or changes speed on its own
items.job: Repair or replace blower motor wiring harness

items.t: Radiator fan stops, causing overheating and weak A/C
items.job: Replace radiator cooling fan motor

items.t: Water leaks into the trunk
items.job: Seal trunk drain holes

items.t: Rear wheels chatter in slow turns
items.job: Service rear differential and replace limited-slip clutch pack
items.note: A fluid change with friction modifier is often enough.

items.t: Delay before Reverse engages
items.job: Adjust shift cable or replace detent spring

items.t: Airbag or seat belt warning light stays on
items.job: Diagnose airbag system and repair sensor or wiring
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $300 to $700.

items.t: Serpentine belt slips off in wet weather
items.job: Replace belt tensioner pulley and drive belt
items.note: If the water pump also needs replacing, add about $100-200 in parts and 2 hours.

items.t: Long crank or stall from sticking idle air valve
items.job: Clean or replace idle air control valve

items.t: Squeal from belt tensioner or idler pulley on cold starts
items.job: Replace belt tensioner or idler pulley and belt

items.t: Rattle or buzz from exhaust heat shields
items.job: Secure loose heat shields
